# Vintage Clothing Guides

> > Comprehensive authentication and identification guides for vintage clothing, designer labels, fabrics, and care techniques.

Vintage Clothing Guides (VCG) is a resource founded by experts including Ryan Sanderson and contributors like Vivienne Chase and Robert Staines. The site helps collectors, resellers on platforms like eBay, Etsy, Vinted, Depop, and Poshmark authenticate vintage items through detailed logo, tag, and fabric identification guides.

## Key Topics

- Vintage authentication
- Clothing tags and labels
- Logo identification
- Tag dating
- Brand authentication
- Designer labels
- Fabric identification
- Textile guides
- Vintage clothing care
- Label history
- Sportswear authentication
- Luxury fashion authentication
- Vintage reselling
- Clothing alteration

- [How to tell if Ann Demeulemeester is vintage: Logos, Tags & Tips](https://vintageclothingguides.com/tags-labels/how-to-tell-if-ann-demeulemeester-is-vintage): Designer label authentication guide for Ann Demeulemeester vintage items
- [How to tell if Evan Picone is vintage: Logos, Tags & Tips](https://vintageclothingguides.com/tags-labels/how-to-tell-if-evan-picone-is-vintage): Evan Picone vintage fashion label dating and authentication guide
